witnesses.comparison: Local error is explicitly nonmonotonic in general; no global-distance guarantee.
The five forms use approximation signs for functions; linear model equality is separate, including zero slope.
Exact time law is normalized and the time factor is restored for an absolute interval.
The clock substitution is explicitly u=-q, r=-1/2, and both coefficients are computed.
Linear/quadratic remainder ratios and sufficient regularity license exact derivatives and divided limits.
Degree-at-most-two derivative matching is distinguished from an interval least-squares fit.
Radians, positive real domains, fixed exponent, speed domain, dimensionless q, coefficient-sensitive locality and needed tolerance are explicit.
The same events, onboard time and synchronized reference clocks define an inertial gravity-free model; signal travel and real GPS corrections are distinguished.
Fractions and absolute time are separate; the interval and tolerance govern relevance, no universal current best-clock claim or complete error bound is inferred.
